description: The bar chart compares the distribution of three components—Context, Generated Response, and Other—across two categories, "Ours" and "Standard," as presented in the paper titled "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision." The horizontal axis represents the two categories, "Ours" and "Standard," while the vertical axis shows the percentage distribution of the components. Each bar is segmented into three colored portions: blue for Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other. For the "Ours" category, the Context component accounts for 60.6%, the Generated Response for 31.7%, and the Other for 7.7%. In contrast, for the "Standard" category, the Context component is 23.6%, the Generated Response is 51.1%, and the Other is 25.3%. The legend at the bottom of the chart identifies the color coding for each component. The chart visually demonstrates that the "Ours" approach places a significantly higher emphasis on Context compared to the "Standard" approach, while the "Standard" approach relies more heavily on the Generated Response.
